business_problem: Remote Legal needed a reliable and cost-efficient way to run remote depositions, deliver accurate real-time transcription, and keep legal proceedings stable enough that sessions could start and finish on the platform without costly failures.
solution_summary: Remote Legal built its remote deposition platform on AWS using ASP.NET Core SignalR containers on AWS Fargate and an Application Load Balancer to support near-real-time courtroom-style collaboration over the web. Deposition session state and application data are stored in Amazon RDS, while audio from live sessions is sent to Amazon Transcribe to generate accurate text with seamless integration into the rest of the stack. The team manages the entire environment as infrastructure as code, which lets it recreate identical testing, proof-of-concept, or disaster-recovery environments in new regions quickly. This combination gives Remote Legal a scalable legal-technology platform that can support live depositions, simplify transcription, and keep reliability high without managing servers.

solution_components.name: AWS Fargate
solution_components.role: Runs the containerized ASP.NET Core SignalR application without server management.

solution_components.name: Application Load Balancer
solution_components.role: Routes deposition traffic to the application based on request content.

solution_components.name: Amazon RDS
solution_components.role: Stores Remote Legal's application and deposition data.

solution_components.name: Amazon Transcribe
solution_components.role: Converts live deposition speech to text as part of the platform workflow.

data_flow: Deposition participants connect through the web application running on AWS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer, deposition data is stored in Amazon RDS, and live speech is sent to Amazon Transcribe so the platform can return accurate text during proceedings.
business_outcome: Remote Legal built the solution in 10 months, migrated to Amazon Transcribe in 1 week, virtually removed transcription errors, achieved a 98 percent deposition success rate, and cut testing and demo costs by 85 percent through automation on AWS.
metrics: 10 months to build a remote deposition solution
